items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk-led SpaceX's first week as a public company sparks market mania
items.summary_cn: SpaceX上市首周引爆市场狂热，间接利好持有SPCH（2倍做多SpaceX ETF）的多头情绪，但SpaceX本身未上市无直接ticker。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk's SpaceX Moves into Chip Manufacturing
items.summary_cn: SpaceX进军芯片制造（自研），加强其垂直整合与AI算力叙事，间接利好SPCH及半导体供应链情绪。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk to get a billion shares of SpaceX if he can settle a million humans on Mars
items.summary_cn: Musk获100亿股SpaceX股权激励，条件是殖民火星100万人——强化长期看多叙事，对SPCH情绪面利好。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX's successful IPO shows that Elon Musk has a real product, says Walter Isaacson
items.summary_cn: 传记作者Isaacson公开背书SpaceX IPO，称Musk有'真产品'，间接为SpaceX估值与SPCH多头背书。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Did Elon Musk Just Hint a SpaceX-Tesla Merger Is Imminent?
items.summary_cn: Musk被传暗示SpaceX-Tesla合并临近，纯猜测性质、涉及未上市公司，但暗示两家关联公司资本运作。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX handed lowest possible ESG rating by MSCI
items.summary_cn: MSCI给SpaceX最低ESG评级，属于舆论/资金面利空但对股价影响有限；SPCH持有者需留意ESG基金被动减持风险。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Keir Starmer will resign as Prime Minister of The United Kingdom. He failed badly on two very important subjects- IMMIGRATION AND ENERGY (OPEN NORTH SEA OIL!). I wish him well! President DJT
items.summary_cn: Trump抨击英国首相Starmer并点名要求'开放北海石油'，暗示对英国能源政策不满及对油气板块的态度。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk says Tesla's Cybercab has started production
items.summary_cn: Musk宣布Tesla Cybercab已启动生产，Robotaxi商业化进入实质阶段——Tesla未在kcn持仓中，但属重大产业催化剂。

items.author: Trump
items.text: The headline in the Corrupt and Failing New York Times: “What Changed After Almost 4 Months of War? Analysts Say Not Much.” REALLY? Their Military is DONE, their Navy is GONE, their Air Force is GONE, their Launching Pads, Missiles, Drones and Manufacturing of same, is almost GONE, their top two sets of Leaders are GONE, their Inflation is at 250%, their Economy is BROKEN, their Soldiers aren’t being paid, the Hormuz Strait is OPEN, THE OIL IS GUSHING, and the U.S. Stock Market and Jobs are at record HIGHS. That’s what’s CHANGED, you corrupt and unethical cowards, and MORE!!! President DJT
items.summary_cn: Trump宣称伊朗军事力量已崩溃、霍尔木兹海峡开放、油价畅通、且美股与就业创历史新高，传递地缘缓和+能源供应恢复+美股看多信号。

items.author: Trump
items.text: There will be NO TOLLS in the  Hormuz Strait for 60 days during the Cease Fire Period, and there will be NO TOLLS after the 60 day period has expired, unless they are imposed by and for the United States of America, should the deal not be completed, for services rendered as the Guardian Angel to the countries of the Middle East for purposes of both past, present, and future reimbursement of costs. Thank you for your attention to this matter!!! President DJT
items.summary_cn: Trump宣布霍尔木兹海峡60天停火期内免通行费，60天后除非美方征收否则也不收费——直接影响全球油运成本与中东原油供应定价。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk 'needs to answer' for 4.5M kids 'sentenced to death' over DOGE cuts, Ro Khanna argues
items.summary_cn: 民主党议员Ro Khanna公开要求Musk为DOGE削减致450万儿童'被判死刑'负责——DOGE削减议题升温，可能影响联邦支出/医保板块情绪。
